notes.title: A Very Challenge Mode Christmas!
notes.content:
Happy Holidays, friends! Ready for something sweet?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089279/3e40b7fbbec208fef85d70c7933ed6df2c132be3.png

Buckle up for Holiday Hard-Mode with the all-new "Challenge Mode" in A Christmas Peril! Put your snow-slinging skills to the test with a full day of snowball fights.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089279/cb09a0343e45b9cc62ae6058123a9254b5b7a7fd.png

Four locations. Eight fights of increasing difficulty. No redos! If you fall in a flurry of snowy glory, you'll have to start all the way back at the beginning. Now what are you waiting for? Get to it! Overcome the ultimate Christmas Peril and post that victory screen to show your friends who's boss this holidays!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089279/d1bbd9a3481c288b373cb54a091b45978856e5c7.png

P.S. We've also added an 'About' page in the main menu to briefly talk about the charity we are supporting, LOFT Community Services. We love all you folks for your support for this wonderful cause!

Happy Holidays,
- The 'A Christmas Peril' Team
